slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the warehouse capacity limit of 500 units a constraint on the inventory level at the end of each month, or does it also apply to the inventory level during the month before purchases and sales are settled?
slot_scores.rationale: The question addresses intra-month capacity timing and mentions purchases/sales settlement, a related issue, but it does not explicitly ask when purchases occur within the month (e.g., beginning vs. end).

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchase timing within the month can be ignored; the model only needs end-of-month inventory balances and does not need to know whether purchases occur at the beginning or end of the month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the timing of purchases; it only asked whether capacity applies during the month, then adopted a monthly inventory balance without stating the purchase timing assumption.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 purchase-timing slot was only partially covered and never explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent clarified many modeling details, but it did not explicitly recover the hidden purchase-timing fact and stopped with that P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
